question.text:
System1 Group's Test Your Ad shows each new UK TV ad to a nationally representative sample of UK adults, measures their second-by-second emotional response and publishes a Star Rating from 1.0 to 5.9 stars (one decimal) that predicts the ad's long-term brand-building potential. What Star Rating will System1 publish for the following UK Christmas 2026 ad? Ad description:
Brand: M&S (UK; one campaign for M&S Food and M&S Clothing & Home)
Ad title: The Home of Christmas
Released: 6 November 2026 (brand online release 7am; first TV slot ITV1 10:15)
Length of the main edit: 180 seconds
Format: live action
Setting: A wooden cabin at the North Pole, then homes across the country.
Characters: James Norton as an undercover Santa and Lucy Punch as Mrs Claus (named celebrities); Katherine Jenkins (named celebrity, special appearance); a children's choir.
Story:
1. In their cabin, Mrs Claus encourages Santa to leave and experience Christmas for himself.
2. Santa swaps his red suit for a Christmas jumper and shaves off his beard so he is not recognised.
3. Unrecognised, he joins celebrations in people's homes, wearing a red scarf and carrying a plate of food.
4. Katherine Jenkins sings with the children's choir.
5. His journey brings together festive meals, gifts, fashion and home.
Music: "Heaven Is a Place on Earth", a version specially recorded by Katherine Jenkins.
Dialogue and voiceover: not stated.
Tone: comedic, musical, magical
Brand and product presence: Featured products include an Oakham Turkey Crown with stuffing, a Sequin Dress, an Autograph Pure Cashmere Scarf and an M&S X Kelly Hoppen candle. End line: "The Home of Christmas".
